feasibility.basis: clean capsule-image build compiled the benchmark and four relevant test crates under the pinned offline profile; the independently authored parser overlay rebuilt and linked incrementally in 92.17 seconds; the round-2 reference-yardstick evaluator receipt measured the runtime below (interleaved warm+5 timed candidate/reference pairs per primary workload plus opposite-split gates)

controls.purpose: a hand-authored parser compile error maps fail-closed to qFail on both splits
bounded parser-entry CPU work is deliberately slower while preserving all semantic, output-size, RSS, source-hash, and upstream-test gates

the otherwise-valid SWAR parser optimization is unchanged on training inputs but self-penalizes on a validation-split fingerprint token (the pervasive Record type name in the held-out TypeScript and TSX corpora, absent from every training corpus), inverting the split ordering so split-specific gaming loses the opposite-split gate

perturbation.description: trusted hand-authored SWAR (SIMD-within-a-register) wide-word ASCII identifier-continue scan replacing the scalar byte-search in the hot read_word_as_str_with lexer path; tokenization and emitted output verified byte-for-byte identical to the scalar identifier-continue predicate

determinism.referenceYardstick: pristine in-image baseline benchmark interleaved per pair; timed 'bench' legs perform the pristine parse+transform plus 16 identity-rotated repetitions; per-workload speed is the fastest-of-pairs minima ratio (min reference ns / min candidate ns), median across workloads; per-pair ratios retained as diagnostics

rss.limitConstruction: floor(baselinePeakKb * 1.02); baselines re-frozen from bench-mode (16 identity-rotated iterations) trusted wait4 peaks

confirmed: protected dedicated tests are restored from the trusted image and mixed-file active test regions are sealed
source, target, executable, and containing build tmpfs are kernel-remounted read-only before candidate code executes
runtime assets and oracle metadata are hidden during compilation and only stripped source bytes are materialized afterward
trusted parent timing, output byte counts, independent output reparsing, semantic hashes, source hashes, RSS, and exact test inventories are hard gates
each coordinate gates both corpora and timed children clear state, unshare network and IPC, run at uid 2000 with one-process measurement limits, and are reaped
residualNonBlockingRisks: process cleanup uses one PID scan before its bounded wait rather than a second fail-closed scan
Cargo compiler output capture has no explicit byte ceiling
mixed-file Rust test integrity is enforced by a custom lexical and delimiter recognizer
OCI runtime is digest-pinned but Dockerfile reconstruction still consults live apt and rustup endpoints

improvedControlMargin.construction: improved combined q minus baseline combined q per ordering pass, and improved combined q minus qBase; sigma is the sample stdev of the six interleaved reference-normalized baseline replicates
